name: OKC_ART_INT_BATPROCS_ALL
description: An internal system table that stores the batch process parameters and statistics for each import run.

columns.name: BATCH_PROCESS_ID
columns.description: Primary key to identify the batch process run.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: BATCH_NUMBER
columns.description: Value for Batch process parameter for the run.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: VALIDATE_ONLY_YN
columns.description: Yes/No flag to indicate the value for 'Validate Only' parameter for this run.  If 'Y', then it has been run in validation mode. If 'N', then it has been run in import mode.

columns.name: FETCH_SIZE
columns.description: Value for the parameter "Commit Size" for this run.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Time stamp for the beginning of the run

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Time stamp for the end of the run

columns.name: TOTAL_ROWS_PROCESSED
columns.description: The total number of rows processed for this run.

columns.name: TOTAL_ROWS_FAILED
columns.description: The number of rows failed in the run.

columns.name: TOTAL_ROWS_WARNED
columns.description: The number of rows processed with warnings.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: IMPORT_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of the Import

columns.name: GLOBAL_FLAG
columns.description: Value of the Global Flag that will be defaulted in case of it is not provided in the XML Based Clause Import

columns.name: CLAUSE_STATUS
columns.description: Value of the Clause Status that will be defaulted in case of it is not provided in the XML Based Clause Import

columns.name: ENTITY
columns.description: Entity to which, batch number created for Import corresponds. It includes CLAUSES,VARIABLES,VALUESETS,VSVALUES,RELATIONSHIPS

columns.name: SOURCE_FILE_NAME
columns.description: Source File name from where the data is imported

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: PROGRAM_NAME
columns.description: Identifies the concurrent program

columns.name: PROGRAM_APP_NAME
columns.description: Identifies the Application name spawning the Concurrent Request
